stories.headline: Taiwan exports hit record on AI-chip demand
stories.summary: Taiwan's September exports rose 60.9% from a year earlier to a record $87.22 billion, beating forecasts. AI chips and computing products drove the gain, although energy costs and questions about the durability of AI spending remain risks.

stories.headline: Samsung forecasts record $80 billion profit
stories.summary: Samsung projected a nearly ninefold rise in quarterly operating profit as AI demand drives a memory-chip shortage. Its shares slipped as investors questioned whether the boom is sustainable; detailed results are due October 29.

stories.headline: US voters want stronger action on AI risks
stories.summary: A Reuters/Ipsos poll found 57% of registered voters say the Trump administration is not taking AI risks seriously enough, while 84% see AI as a threat to workers. The online survey's margin of error was two percentage points.

stories.headline: Ukraine strike death toll rises to at least 32
stories.summary: Ukrainian authorities raised the death toll from Russia's missile and drone attack to at least 32, with about 100 injured. Russia said it targeted military-industrial sites; Ukraine reported residential and energy damage.

stories.headline: Hormuz vessel traffic falls after attacks
stories.summary: Commodity-vessel transits fell to their lowest level since July 23 after tanker attacks intensified. Crude flow through Hormuz dropped to 74% of its prewar level, although alternative Gulf of Oman and Red Sea exports offset much of the loss.
